Needs the module: the MODIFY_PHONE_STATE permission is missing.
USB (default, recommended): keep ws://127.0.0.1:8765. The PC program forwards this port over the USB cable with adb reverse automatically.
Wi-Fi: enter the address shown by the PC program, for example ws://192.0.2.10:8787/ws?token=… The phone and the PC must be on the same network.
The address must start with ws:// or wss:// and include a host.
Saved. The service was restarted to use the new address.
Saved. To use the new address, tap Stop service and then Start service when no call is in progress.
Use a dedicated phone. The module takes over the phone app, silences the ringer and turns on Do Not Disturb, so the phone no longer works as a normal handset.
To go back to a normal phone, disable or remove the module in Magisk or KernelSU and reboot. If the Google Phone app or the ringer is still off afterwards, follow the rollback steps in the README.
Laws on recording calls and on telling callers that they are talking to an AI differ from place to place. Following them is your responsibility.
